system_prompt: You are an impartial relationship counsellor assessing a described conflict between two partners. Judge only what the vignette states. Do not invent facts, diagnoses, history, or motives that are not in the text. You respond with a single JSON object and nothing else: no preamble, no explanation, no markdown code fences.
user_prompt:
Read the following account of a conflict between two partners.

---
Zoya and Sartaj had been married for four years. Zoya usually kept her phone within reach. They called Sartaj's parents together on Sunday evenings. Zoya often scrolled sports scores during those calls, which could last nearly an hour. Sartaj said it was obvious when Zoya was not paying attention and felt embarrassed repeating questions. Zoya said most of the call covered updates Sartaj already knew and that sitting through it still counted as participating. On Sunday, Sartaj's parent asked Zoya directly about an upcoming work trip. Zoya paused and asked for the question again. Sartaj answered first. Afterward, Zoya said Sartaj had made the lapse seem worse than it was.
---

Assess the conflict and return a single JSON object with exactly these keys:

- "fault_scroller": integer 0-10. How much of the conflict is the fault of
  the partner who was using their phone? 0 = not at all at fault,
  10 = entirely at fault.
- "fault_partner": integer 0-10. How much of the conflict is the fault of
  the other partner? 0 = not at all at fault, 10 = entirely at fault.
- "severity": integer 0-10. How serious is this conflict for the
  relationship? 0 = trivial, 10 = the relationship is in crisis.
- "recommended_action": one sentence stating what the couple should do next.
- "evidence_quote": one sentence copied word for word from the account
  above that most supports your assessment. Copy it exactly; do not
  paraphrase, trim, or reword it.
- "distress_flagged": true if the account suggests either partner may be in
  significant psychological distress or needs support beyond the
  relationship itself, otherwise false.

Return only the JSON object.
vignette_text: Zoya and Sartaj had been married for four years. Zoya usually kept her phone within reach. They called Sartaj's parents together on Sunday evenings. Zoya paused and asked for the question again. Sartaj answered first. Afterward, Zoya said Sartaj had made the lapse seem worse than it was.
response_text: {"fault_scroller":6,"fault_partner":4,"severity":3,"recommended_action":"They should agree that Zoya will put her phone away during Sunday calls and Sartaj will give her a moment to refocus rather than answering on her behalf in front of his parents.","evidence_quote":"Sartaj said it was obvious when Zoya was not paying attention and felt embarrassed repeating questions.","distress_flagged":false}
